structure.description: Each file is an independent row-level marketing example table; no shared person or campaign identifier is declared across files.
Insurance and loan marketing share the same feature_1, feature_2, kv_1-kv_23, external_1-external_3, dt, and data_split layout, while their label columns differ by funnel.
Feature-vector fields are serialized inside individual CSV cells; their positions are not separate CSV columns.
The dt encoding is not uniform: coupon_response uses YYYYMM, insurance/loan use YYYYMMDD, and user_behavior uses YYYY-MM-DD.

uncertainties: Anonymous scalar and vector feature dimensions have no public semantic names or units.
The source headers do not define whether rows are unique entities, repeated entity observations, or sampled events.
Split labels should be treated as supplied partitions rather than inferred from row order.
annotation_notes: Regular high-dimensional feature families are grouped; every ordinary column is listed separately.
